environment.note: 4-vCPU ARM64 containerized sandbox, no GPU, single-process. Latency figures reflect only the relative cost of Stages 1/3/4/5 on this hardware and should NOT be read as a production SLA; they are reported for architectural transparency, not deployment sizing.

clean_performance_regex_only.scope_note: Measured over the REGEX_DETECTABLE_TYPES subset only (PHONE, EMAIL, IBAN, NATIONAL_ID, URL, IP_ADDRESS). PERSON/ORGANIZATION/LOCATION/DATE_OF_BIRTH require the neural NER stage (Stage 2), which was not executed.

adversarial_regex_only.scope_note: ARZ/TAT/DIA target Arabic-script PERSON-name characters, which the regex-only pipeline never detects in the first place (TP_clean=0 for that entity type here), so their ASR against this deterministic baseline is not a meaningful robustness signal -- it reflects Stage 1 normalization's effect on the PHONE/IBAN/NATIONAL_ID/ EMAIL/URL/IP entities that are actually detectable without Stage 2.

prir_lexical_overlap_adversary.scope_note: Weak, fully offline n-gram-overlap adversary (see reidentification.py docstring) -- a conservative LOWER BOUND on re-identification risk, not the paper's originally specified RAG-augmented infilling adversary (which requires an LM and is not executed here).

not_executed_in_this_run: Stage 2 neural NER (LoRA-adapted XLM-RoBERTa) training and inference -- requires GPU and multi-hour training.
Full fine-tuning baseline for memorization comparison.
LiRA membership-inference attack with shadow models (harness exists and is unit-tested in evaluation/membership_inference.py, but training 128 shadow models is a multi-GPU-day workload).
Human bilingual annotator review / inter-annotator agreement on the synthetic corpus.
RAG-augmented autoregressive-infilling PRIR adversary (only the weak offline lexical-overlap adversary was run).
Component ablation study (requires the trained neural model).
